candidates.text: HOWEVER, I WANT TO BE CLEAR THAT A SINGLE DEATH IN CUSTODY IS UNACCEPTABLE.

I FOUND THIS HEARING ON IN APRIL BECAUSE THE NUMBER OF DEATHS IN SUFFOLK COUNTY CUSTODY IN RECENT YEARS WHERE THE SERIOUS CONCERNS ABOUT THE SAFETY, THE TREATMENT AND THE CIVIL RIGHTS OF INDIVIDUALS DETAINED IN THESE FAC

THESE CONCERNS ARE ESPECIALLY URGENT FOLLOWING THE DEATH OF COVID KENNY ON DECEMBER 7TH, 2025 WHOSE DEATH WAS SUBSEQUENTLY RULED A HOMICIDE BY THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF MEDICAL EXAMINER, ACCORDING TO THE MEDICAL EXAMINER'S

AND SINCE THE PASSING OF UH, JACOBY KENNEDY, UM IN DECEMBER 2025 HAS BROUGHT TO LIGHT MANY QUESTIONS ABOUT THE USE OF FORCE STAFF CONDUCT AND THE ADEQUATE UH, SEA OF EMERGENCY RESPONSE AND MEDICAL CARE PROVIDED TO INDIVI
MY MOTHER AND SISTER WALK BESIDE ME AND I WAS THE YOUNGEST OF ALL MY MOTHER'S CHILDREN.

I HAD ALWAYS BELIEVED A GUARD WAS SOMEONE WHO PROTECTED US I WAS WRONG THE GUARD, ALSO KNOWN AS CORRECTION OFFICERS WERE HULKING MUSCLED MEN AND THEIR EYES CARRIED A COLDNESS AS IF OUR PRESENCE WERE AN INCONVENIENCE.
I WANTED TO HOLD HIS HAND BUT EVEN THE SMALLEST GESTURE OF LOVE WAS MET WITH AN OBJECTION AND SHOUTING DON'T TOUCH!
I WALKED OUT OF THAT VISITING ROOM STILL PERFORMING BRAVERY I CARRIED WITH ME STILL.
THIS IS AN UNACCEPTABLE CONDITION FOR ANY PERSON.
SOME OF THESE EXPERIENCES CONTINUE TO AFFECT ME TO THIS DAY.
AFTER THE OFFICERS LEFT, ANOTHER OFFICER WORKING THE SHIP FELT BAD FOR DENISE AND PASSED HER NAPKINS AND TOILET PAPER.
IF THEY WERE TRAINED LIKE WE SAY WHY IS MY SON DEAD TODAY?
WHO'S GOING TO FIGHT FOR THEM?

RESCIND THE CITY'S ENCAMPMENT BAN ORDINANCE, DIRECT THE UH BOSTON POLICE DEPARTMENT TO END THE PRACTICES OF WARRANT SWEEPS, DIRECT THE BPD TO END DRUG BASED AND CITY ORDINANCE VIOLATION ARREST AND THE COORDINATED RESPONS
IS STILL ELIGIBLE TO VOTE IN THE COMMONWEALTH.
THAT LAWSUIT SURVIVED A MOTION TO DISMISS A YEAR AGO.
SO WHERE DO YOU COME IN AS INTERESTED AND CURIOUS AND COURAGEOUS CITY COUNCILORS WHO HAVE PASSED.
NEITHER HANDCUFFS NOR KEYS ARE APPROVED WEAPONS UNDER THE DEPARTMENT'S POLICY, BUT ONCE AGAIN POLICY DID NOT CONSTRAIN THE OFFICER'S BEHAVIOR.

I WOULD LOVE FOR US TO BE OUT OF A JOB AND THE ONLY WAY THE WAY THAT WE CAN DO THAT IS IF THE CITY COUNCIL DIRECTS THE BOSTON POLICE DEPARTMENT TO END THE WARRANT SWEEPS AND THE ARRESTS OF PEOPLE WHO ARE USING DRUGS OUTS

THESE TACTICS AND PRACTICES UTILIZED BY THE CITY IN PARTNERSHIP WITH THE SUFFOLK COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT AND THE NEWMARKET BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTRICT INCLUDE CITYWIDE SWEEPS, WARRANT SWEEPS, THE TENT ORDINANCE JAI
PEOPLE HAVE TO DIE BEFORE THEIR CONCERNS BECOME AN EMERGENCY.
